{{Short description|French mathematician}}
'''Éric Leichtnam''' is director of research at the [[CNRS]] at the [[Pierre and Marie Curie University|Institut de Mathématiques de Jussieu]] in Paris. His fields of interest are [[noncommutative geometry]], [[ergodic theory]], [[Dirichlet problem]], [[non-commutative residue]].
